verdict.rationale: RustDesk Server Pro documents its own management API alongside the web console, so a programmatic interface exists. Nothing shows that the API matches the UI's full feature set, and the OSS edition shows no API at all. missing for 10: documentation of API scope and endpoints, evidence of parity with UI/web-console features (address book, access control, settings, sessions), API availability outside the Pro tier, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI

citations.quote: Server Pro adds a web console, device groups, a shared address book, per-user and device-group access control, audit logs, and a management API.
